build_points_rasterizer: build a PointsRasterizer module with cameras and rasterization settings to rasterize a batch of point clouds
create_rasterization_settings: create a PointsRasterizationSettings dataclass to configure image size, radius, and points per pixel for rasterization
test_points_rasterizer_forward: test the PointsRasterizer forward pass by passing point clouds and receiving PointFragments with idx, zbuf, and dists
review_points_rasterizer_transform: review the PointsRasterizer transform method which projects point clouds from world space to NDC space
summarize_pointfragments: summarize the PointFragments NamedTuple which stores idx, zbuf, and dists tensors as rasterization outputs
